{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Average the existing BPR plus 0.2 pointwise loss within each sampled user's valid positions, then across users. Equal user weighting may better align training with user-averaged HR@10 across all four datasets. Model and predictor shapes remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    valid_counts = mask.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)
    user_losses = (loss * mask).sum(dim=1) / valid_counts
    return user_losses.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Change only loss aggregation to give each sampled user equal total weight, retaining the existing objective terms and all training and inference settings."}
